title: Find the display name of the user who owned the post with the highest diffe
question: Find the display name of the user who owned the post with the highest difference between view count and comment count in 2010, where the post has at least 10 comments and was created in a month that had the maximum total number of votes across all months in that year.

prediction.sql:
WITH MaxVoteMonth AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', v."XCL_069") AS VoteMonth
    FROM votes AS v
    WHERE strftime('%Y', v."XCL_069") = '2010'
    GROUP BY VoteMonth
    ORDER BY COUNT(v."XCL_066") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
CandidatePosts AS (
    SELECT 
        p."XCL_026" AS PostId,
        p."XCL_033" AS OwnerId,
        p."XCL_030" AS ViewCount,
        p."XCL_038" AS CommentCount
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE 
        strftime('%Y', p."XCL_029") = '2010'
        AND strftime('%Y-%m', p."XCL_029") = (SELECT VoteMonth FROM MaxVoteMonth)
        AND p."XCL_038" >= 10
)
SELECT 
    u."XCL_055" AS DisplayName
FROM CandidatePosts AS cp
INNER JOIN users AS u ON cp.OwnerId = u."XCL_052"
ORDER BY (cp.ViewCount - cp.CommentCount) DESC
LIMIT 1

    SELECT 
        p."XCL_026" AS PostId,
        p."XCL_033" AS OwnerId,
        p."XCL_030" AS ViewCount,
        p."XCL_038" AS CommentCount
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE 
        strftime('%Y', p."XCL_029") = '2010'
        AND strftime('%Y-%m', p."XCL_029") = (SELECT VoteMonth FROM MaxVoteMonth)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH post_comment_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        p."XCL_026" AS post_id,
        p."XCL_033" AS user_id,
        p."XCL_029" AS creation_date,
        p."XCL_031" AS view_count,
        COUNT(c."XCL_005") AS comment_count
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN comments c ON p."XCL_026" = c."XCL_006"
    WHERE p."XCL_029" LIKE '2010%'
    GROUP BY p."XCL_026", p."XCL_033", p."XCL_029", p."XCL_031"
    HAVING COUNT(c."XCL_005") >= 10
),
monthly_vote_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', v."XCL_069") AS vote_month,
        COUNT(v."XCL_066") AS total_votes
    FROM votes v
    WHERE v."XCL_069" LIKE '2010%'
    GROUP BY vote_month
),
max_vote_month AS (
    SELECT vote_month
    FROM monthly_vote_counts
    ORDER BY total_votes DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
filtered_posts AS (
    SELECT 
        pcc.post_id,
        pcc.user_id,
        pcc.view_count - pcc.comment_count AS diff
    FROM post_comment_counts pcc
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', pcc.creation_date) = (SELECT vote_month FROM max_vote_month)
)
SELECT 
    u."XCL_055" AS display_name
FROM filtered_posts fp
INNER JOIN users u ON fp.user_id = u."XCL_052"
ORDER BY fp.diff DESC
LIMIT 1

)
-- Step 3: Find the post with the highest difference between view count and comment count
SELECT

JOIN 
    users u ON cp.OwnerId = u.XCL_052
